purpose: Crosswalk the global freshwater dataset's northern Luzon Cagayan basin candidate named Stenogobius kyphosus against its original type series, 2023 revision, current Catalog of Fishes, GBIF match, and bounded B0380 coordinate query.

candidate.globalDatasetRole: Basin-level discovery candidate; bibliography reference IDs are not a verified citation-to-basin crosswalk.

originalDescription.citation: Watson, R. E. (1991). A provisional review of the genus Stenogobius with descriptions of a new subgenus and thirteen new species (Pisces: Teleostei: Gobiidae). Records of the Western Australian Museum, 15(3), 571-654.

paratypes.locality: same collection data as holotype; 2025 checklist notes none available in ANSP's record
Nonucan River near Camp Overton, Iligan Bay, Mindanao, Philippines

originalDescription.historicalDistributionStatement: The original description reports the taxon from rivers entering the Mindanao Sea and eastern Mindanao.
originalDescription.localityLimit: Reviewed type localities are in Camiguin, Mindanao, and Leyte. They do not name Cagayan or northern Luzon and provide no coordinates used here.
originalDescription.interpretationLimit: Historical type-series evidence, not current presence, a current range assessment, or evidence of absence from Cagayan.

taxonomicRevision.citation: Causse, R., Mennesson, M. I., Lord, C., & Keith, P. (2023). Stenogobius (Teleostei: Gobioidei) from the Indian-Pacific island rivers. Cybium, 47(2), 141-165. DOI: 10.26028/cybium/2023-011.
taxonomicRevision.access: Full repository-hosted PDF downloaded and directly reviewed; Zenodo record identifies the article and CC BY 4.0 license.
taxonomicRevision.finding: Authors report one widespread S. genivittatus clade with mean COI genetic distance 0.5%, and synonymize 12 names including S. kyphosus with S. genivittatus. The type-material table includes Camiguin lots; the locality summary lists Camiguin, Mindanao, and Leyte, not Cagayan.
taxonomicRevision.scopeLimit: Taxonomic evidence for synonymy; no Cagayan-basin specimen or coordinate for this candidate.

currentCatalogCrosscheck.provider: California Academy of Sciences, Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
currentCatalogCrosscheck.retrieval: Official search-indexed entry excerpt reviewed on 2026-11-06; direct page fetch returned HTTP 403 in the web reader.
currentCatalogCrosscheck.status: Synonym of Stenogobius genivittatus (Valenciennes, 1837), citing Causse et al. 2023:154.
currentCatalogCrosscheck.interpretation: Catalog agrees with the 2023 revision; the historical type locality does not establish northern Luzon presence.

gbifCrossCheck.interpretation: GBIF still treats the candidate name as accepted, unlike the 2023 revision and current Catalog. The bounded zero result is an index result, not absence evidence, and does not resolve citation-to-basin provenance.

localityResolution.basinCrosswalk: No reviewed type locality or revision locality names the northern Luzon Cagayan drainage. The global basin-candidate label remains unsupported by an independently verified Cagayan locality or citation-to-basin crosswalk; this does not establish absence.
localityResolution.evidenceClass: Historical type-series localities outside Cagayan plus taxonomic synonymy; no Cagayan event locality or spatial overlay.

interpretation: Causse et al. (2023) and the current Catalog treat S. kyphosus as a synonym of S. genivittatus, while GBIF still marks S. kyphosus accepted under usage key 2377266.
The original type series and revision locality summary point to Camiguin, Mindanao, and Leyte; reviewed evidence supplies no Cagayan or northern Luzon locality.
The global B0380 association remains a discovery lead: bibliography references are not independently linked to that basin. No biological absence claim is made.
No species, occurrence, geometry, diet, bait, catchability, legal, safety, or public-app row was added.

sources.supports: Directly reviewed 1991 original description, type-series catalog numbers, historical localities, and distribution statement.
Directly reviewed 2023 integrative revision and repository citation/license metadata; article reports the S. kyphosus synonymy.
Current Catalog indexed entry's taxonomic status, reference, type locality, and holotype.
Peer-reviewed 2025 checklist's type locality/paratype cross-check and re-cataloging note.
GBIF strict name match and accepted usage key for candidate name.
GBIF strict name match and separate accepted usage key for S. genivittatus.
Count-only coordinate-bearing Philippines query over rectangular B0380 extent using GBIF's accepted key; response count was zero.

sourcePolicy.rightsReview: Zenodo record states CC BY 4.0 for the 2023 revision. WA Museum source page states Government of Western Australia copyright; no item-specific reuse grant was verified for the 1991 article. Catalog terms were not reviewed. The 2025 checklist is CC BY 4.0. No public-app projection is approved.
sourcePolicy.qualityReview: Taxonomic synonymy does not establish exact locality, current presence, abundance, catchability, legality, or safety. A GBIF accepted-name response is not a final taxonomic adjudication.
sourcePolicy.accessEvidence: The 1991 full text, 2023 revision PDF, and 2025 checklist were directly read. The official CAS status came from an indexed entry excerpt because direct page access was blocked.
